title: ClaimEvidenceLink
description: A versioned, directional edge connecting one Evidence entity to one Claim entity. Polarity (supports/contradicts/etc.) lives HERE, not on the evidence — because the same evidence may support claim A, contradict claim B, and merely contextualise claim C. This is the only place claim-evidence connections are stored; backlinks on claims and evidence are derived by tooling.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:claim_evidence_link:<ulid>.

claim_id.description: The claim this link connects to.

evidence_id.description: The evidence this link connects to.

polarity.description: How this evidence bears on this specific claim. 'corroborates' means it independently confirms other evidence for the claim; 'impeaches' means it undermines the credibility of other evidence or a source relied on by the claim.

strength.description: How directly this evidence bears on the claim, for this link specifically.

reasoning.description: Why this evidence bears on this claim in the stated way. Required in practice for contradicts/impeaches links; enforced by review, not schema.
